Subject: Post-session recap & action items — FinTechCo POC workshop (Jul 7)

Folks — thanks for the productive session today. Below is a concise recap and owners. I kept this tight so we can move quickly.

Recap (high level):
- Prompt review: FinTechCo shared 9 prompts covering KYC summarization and transaction categorization. We observed two prompts that triggered token blowups for unusually long system messages — Dev provided a trimming recommendation.
- Routing: Demonstrated policy-based routing (tier-1 low-latency model vs tier-2 economical variant). Verified fallback to tier-2 during simulated capacity constraint.
- Load tests: Ran staged bursts up to 200 requests/min with 300-token average response. Latency SLO met for tier-1 at steady-state; spikes observed during concurrent large-batch jobs.

Action items:
1) FinTechCo to upload annotated prompt set to shared Drive (Samantha) — due: 2026-07-09.
2) Dev to implement prompt trimming guardrail & push patch to POC config (Dev Patel) — due: 2026-07-12.
3) Rishi to provide cost estimate for sustained 200 req/min profile including dedicated capacity options (Rishi Malhotra) — due: 2026-07-14.
4) Marissa to schedule the next deep-dive (Routing + KV cache behavior) — proposed window: Jul 15–16 (Marissa Cole) — invite to follow.
5) Neha to circulate a short technical handoff doc and update HubSpot with notes (Neha Kapoor) — due: 2026-07-09.

Attachments: post-session-notes-FTC.docx (detailed logs and screenshots).

If anything here looks off, call it out and I’ll update. Thanks again — great momentum.
